blurb: The Halifax Ghost Walk is the longest running ghost walk in Halifax. We do not use third party booking sites. Book direct.Join us for a 1 hour and 40 minute walk through Halifax’s historic city streets with tales of ghosts, spirits, forerunners and devils with maybe a hanging or two thrown in for good measure. Stories collected from the folklore of Nova Scotia.All supported with a good dose of local history to give
